name: Morgan's Vigil
summary: Morgan's Vigil is a ruined Alliance redoubt nestled in the southeastern heights of the Burning Steppes. Once a small village, its charred homes and shattered wizard's tower now serve as an austere forward camp for scouts watching the passes to Blackrock Mountain. It remains the sole Alliance foothold in an ash-choked land dominated by Dark Iron dwarves and Blackrock orcs.

sections.title: The Last Hearth in the Steppes
sections.body: Perched upon high stone overlooking the fiery wastes, Morgan's Vigil was once a modest settlement before the horrors of the Burning Steppes overran it. Today, charred timbers and the cracked shell of a ruined mage tower stand as grim reminders of the onslaught. The remaining defenders make do beneath rough canvas tents pitched amid the soot. Despite the ruin, the camp retains a gryphon roost, offering an unbroken aerial link back across the mountains to Stormwind City. It serves as a desperately needed haven where scouts, marshals, and passing adventurers catch their breath away from the marauding warbands below.

sections.title: The Long Watch
sections.body: The outpost draws its name and purpose from the vigilance kept against the looming threat of Blackrock Mountain. With the Dark Iron clan delving deep into dark sorceries and the Blackrock orcs claiming the surrounding wastes, the camp acts as a forward staging ground. Its defenders maintain the camp's defenses, coordinate scouting runs across the ash, and secure the vital pass leading south into Redridge.

faq.q: What happened to the buildings here?
faq.answer: The settlement was largely burned to the ground by hostile forces roaming the Burning Steppes, likely Blackrock orcs or Dark Iron dwarves. The stone shell of the collapsed mage tower and charred wood foundations are all that survive, forcing the current garrison to sleep under canvas tents.
Morgan is the woman after whom the vigil is named. She is not among the defenders currently stationed at the camp.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance maintain this camp?
faq.answer: It serves as the Alliance's only fortified vantage point in the Burning Steppes, guarding the northern pass to Redridge and keeping watch over troop movements around Blackrock Mountain while receiving swift supplies and reinforcements directly from Stormwind.

faq.q: How can I travel to and from Morgan's Vigil?
aliases: how to get to morgans vigil
faq.answer: The outpost maintains an Alliance gryphon master connecting directly to Stormwind City and Thorium Point across the Searing Gorge.

faq.q: Is Morgan's Vigil safe from attack?
faq.answer: It is heavily guarded by Alliance sentries, but the perimeter is constantly exposed to wandering beasts, fiery elementals, and raiding orcs lurking just outside the ridge.

angles.text: This battered bluff is your solitary safe sanctuary in the Burning Steppes, linking directly by flight to Stormwind City while marshaling resistance against the Dark Iron and Blackrock threats.
Holding this ridge prevents the horrors spawned beneath Blackrock Mountain from pouring unchecked through the pass into the vulnerable valleys of Redridge and the heart of Stormwind.
